featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered Mer Konfekt products on Zomato

Gluten free Almond Cup Cakes - Description - says almond flour jaggery and belgian chocolate - No ingredients list on product - taste was good so reordered to realise
Brookie bars - Description - zero maida atop jowar cookie - no ingredient list on package says 100% whole wheat - no mention of jowar
Sprouted Moong Herb Chia Bread - Description says sprouted moong - ingredient list has white flour n jaggery
Buck Wheat Pizza base - description none - infredient list is clean - buckwheat flour pink salt olive oil apple cider vinegar water

So descrete ingredient lists are there - half declared descriptions misguiding customers -

kindly stop misguiding customers !

This was my last order to you unless you change your practices

featured_reviews.name: saumya poddar
featured_reviews.review_text: The breads here are advertised as healthy, but once I received the product and checked the ingredient list, it clearly mentioned white flour (maida). This is extremely disappointing and misleading. Customers who are consciously choosing healthier options trust such claims, and this kind of marketing breaks that trust. Selling products under the label of “healthy” while using refined flour feels dishonest. Brands and bakeries must be transparent about ingredients instead of misleading customers in the name of health.

featured_reviews.name: HARSHA PRAJAPATI
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered two peanut butter cans from Zomato on 9th feb 2025 evening but one of the can was already opened, with black greasy paste around the tin and bottle neck area with manufacture date removed. I tried calling the shop multiple times but no one pick up and tried connecting with Zomato support team but they dismissed my concern as situational issue. This entire experience was disappointing. Please upgrade your food quality and service

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text: After trying Mer Konfekt once, it has become my daily go-to for all bakery products and a staple when hosting parties. I commend their dedication to vegetarian, cruelty-free, and healthy options, including fantastic vegan choices. Every bite is guilt-free and delicious. I highly recommend this bakery for its quality and diverse offerings!

featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Warden Bakery situated at August Kranti Maiden. Just next to Camy Wafer shop.
The name bakery itself is a self explanatory name where you can avail various biscuits, breads, pastries.
You can really enjoy the fresh baked breads, you name it and all sort of breads are available - Pizza, Dabeli, Garlic, Sweet, Regular breads to name a few.
Their pastries are exclusive, you will not find them at any other place.
The Almond tart, Butterscotch tart, Coconut biscuits, cream rolls, just fantastic, one cannot stop eating.
You can even purchase Mayoniese, Ketchups, different sauces required for preparing Pizzas and other tantalizing dishes.
Chocolate, Strawberry pastries - Oh My God!
Quick service and staff informs the customer to maintain safe distance.
It is open till 8.30 p.m.
Don't miss an opportunity to enjoy their mouth watering tarts, if one is present in the nearby area.

featured_reviews.name: Sonam Pawar - Nucleus Technologies
featured_reviews.review_text:
Edward Bakery, nestled in the heart of Fort on Perin Nariman Street, Borabazar Precinct, is a charming old-world gem that has been serving its patrons for an impressive 90 years. This historic bakery is a must-visit if you're in the Ballard Estate area.

Food Quality:
Edward Bakery is renowned for its wide range of freshly baked goods, all prepared in-house with great care and attention to detail. The quality of their products is exceptional, with everything tasting fresh and flavorful. The highlight of their menu is the Puffs, which are a must-try. These are flaky, buttery, and filled with deliciousness—truly one of the best puffs you'll find in Mumbai.

Ambience & Service:
The bakery exudes an old-world charm with its classic interiors, reminding you of the rich heritage and history it carries. The staff are friendly and efficient, ensuring you have a pleasant experience whether you're picking up a quick snack or browsing through their selection.

Overall Experience:
Edward Bakery is more than just a place to grab a bite—it's a slice of Mumbai's culinary history. Whether you're in the mood for their famous puffs, freshly baked bread, or a variety of other bakery items, you won't be disappointed. The consistent quality and freshness of their offerings make it a beloved spot for both locals and visitors alike.

If you're in Fort, make sure to stop by Edward Bakery for a taste of tradition and some truly delicious treats!
